CZECLANG 1: First Year first quarter Czech is the first course in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes developing basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Czech culture.
CZECLANG 2: Continuation of CZECLANG 1. First Year Second quarter Czech is the second course in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes further development of basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Czech culture. Prerequisite: CZECLANG 1 or placement test
CZECLANG 21: Continuation of CZECLANG 3. Second Year Czech, First Quarter in a three quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture with an emphasis on developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: CZECLANG 3 or placement test.
CZECLANG 22: Continuation of CZECLANG 21. Second Year Czech, Second Quarter in a three quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture with an emphasis on further developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: CZECLANG 21 or placement test.
CZECLANG 395: Prerequisite: For Grad Students Only and Consent of Instructor
